title: Expression-Diverse References for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
title_zh: 身份保持的视频生成：多样化表情参考

paragraphs.en: Identity-preserving video generation aims to maintain a subject’s identity while synthesizing realistic videos. Yet a single reference portrait captures the subject’s appearance under only one facial configuration. As expressions change, facial appearance can vary in highly identity-specific ways, leaving the subject’s appearance under unseen expressions underdetermined by the reference alone. This expression-dependent variation also complicates evaluation: similarity to a neutral reference may decrease under strong expressions even for real images of the same person. We investigate this limitation from both generation and evaluation perspectives. First, we quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity using controlled photographs and MEAD videos. We then construct a compact yet expressive reference gallery that captures diverse expression-dependent facial configurations. Matching against this gallery provides a more robust measure of identity similarity under expressive motion. To further expose performance degradation with expression intensity, we report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions. For generation, we extend Stand-In to condition on our expression-diverse reference sets and develop a data-curation pipeline that extracts consistent yet diverse face crops from training videos. In practical settings where only a single portrait is available, we construct the reference set by synthesizing additional expressions with a pretrained facial reenactment model. On our controlled benchmark of 10 subjects and 48 prompts per subject, both real and synthesized reference sets outperform the evaluated baselines in identity similarity across all three expression-intensity regimes, with the largest improvements for extreme expressions. In this regime, nearest-gallery CurricularFace similarity increases from 60.95 for the strongest baseline to 74.80 with real reference sets and 68.36 with synthesized reference sets. These results show that representing an identity with an expression-diverse reference gallery substantially improves identity preservation under expressive motion.
paragraphs.zh: 身份保留视频生成旨在在合成逼真视频的同时保持主体的身份特征。 然而，单张参考肖像仅能捕捉主体在单一面部姿态下的外观。 随着表情的变化，面部外观可能以高度依赖身份特征的方式发生差异，导致仅凭参考图像无法充分确定主体在未见过表情下的外观。 这种依赖于表情的变化也增加了评估的复杂性：即使对于同一个人的真实图像，在强烈表情下与中性参考图像的相似度也可能降低。 我们从生成和评估两个角度研究了这一局限性。 首先，我们利用受控照片和 MEAD 视频，量化了面部识别相似度如何随表情强度而变化。 接着，我们构建了一个紧凑但富有表现力的参考图库，以捕捉多样化的、依赖于表情的面部姿态。 通过与该图库进行匹配，可以在表情动作下更可靠地衡量身份相似度。 为了进一步揭示性能随表情强度下降的情况，我们分别报告了轻度、强烈和极端表情下的身份相似度。 在生成方面，我们将 Stand-In 扩展为以我们构建的表情多样化参考集为条件，并开发了一条数据整理流程，用于从训练视频中提取一致且多样化的面部裁剪。 在实际应用中，若仅有一张肖像可用，我们可以通过预训练的 facial reenactment 模型合成更多表情来构建参考集。 在我们的受控基准测试中（包含 10 名主体和每位主体 48 个提示），无论是真实还是合成的参考集，在所有三种表情强度区间内，其身份相似度均优于所评估的基线模型，尤其在极端表情下的提升最为显著。 在这一区间内，最近邻图库 CurricularFace 的相似度从最强基线模型的 60.95 提升至使用真实参考集时的 74.80，以及使用合成参考集时的 68.36。 这些结果表明，使用表情多样化的参考图库来表示身份特征，能够显著提升在表情动作下的身份保留效果。

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-video models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) can synthesize realistic and diverse videos from natural-language prompts. Identity-preserving video generation extends this capability by introducing visual references to control the identity of the generated subject while following the text prompt. Recent methods build on pretrained video generators and incorporate reference-conditioning mechanisms to preserve the target identity throughout generation ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) . Strong facial expressions pose a particular challenge: a person should remain recognizable even as their eyes, mouth, cheeks, and skin undergo substantial changes. A single portrait, as adopted by Zhong et al. (2025) ; Yuan et al. (2025b) , captures only one facial configuration and provides limited evidence of these person-specific appearance changes (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 近期的文本到视频模型（Wan 等，2025；Yang 等，2024；Gao 等，2025）能够根据自然语言提示生成逼真且多样化的视频。 保留身份特征的视频生成技术通过引入视觉参考来控制所生成主体的身份特征，同时遵循文本提示，从而扩展了这一能力。 近期的方法基于预训练的视频生成器，并引入了参考条件机制，以在整个生成过程中保留目标身份特征（Wang 等，2026；Xue 等，2026）。 强烈的面部表情构成了一个特殊挑战：即使眼睛、嘴巴、脸颊和皮肤发生显著变化，人物仍然应当具有可识别性。 单张肖像照，如 Zhong 等（2025）；Yuan 等 （2025b）所采用的方式，仅捕捉了单一的面部形态，且无法充分反映这些因人而异的外观变化（图1）。

paragraphs.en: This limitation affects both generation and evaluation. In generation, single-reference methods can lose identity fidelity as expression intensity (the degree to which a facial expression deviates from neutral) increases (Figure 6 ). In evaluation, comparing each generated face only with a neutral reference can conflate expression variation with identity error. We observe this effect even in real images: across 70 non-neutral photographs of 10 subjects, CurricularFace ( Huang et al., 2020 ) similarity to each subject’s neutral reference decreases with expression intensity (Spearman ρ = − 0.701 \rho=-0.701 ) (Figure 3(a) ). We observe a similar trend on a larger-scale video dataset, MEAD ( Wang et al., 2020 ) (Table 1 ). Thus, single-reference similarity can be a suboptimal metric for identity consistency under strong expression changes.
paragraphs.zh: 这一局限性同时影响了生成和评估。 在生成过程中，随着表情强度（即面部表情偏离中性状态的程度）的增加，单参考方法可能会失去身份一致性（图6）。 在评估中，若仅将每个生成的面孔与中性参考进行比较，可能会将表情变化与身份错误混为一谈。 即使在真实图像中，我们也观察到了这一效应：在70张非中性表情的10位受试者照片中，CurricularFace（Huang等，2020）与每位受试者中性参考的相似度随表情强度的增加而降低（Spearman ρ = −0.701 \rho=-0.701）（图3(a)）。 在一个更大规模的视频数据集MEAD（Wang等，2020）中，我们也观察到了类似趋势（表1）。 因此，在表情变化剧烈的情况下，单参考相似度可能并非衡量身份一致性的最佳指标。

paragraphs.en: We study expression-diverse references as a shared basis for conditioning and evaluation. For evaluation, we collect a standardized gallery of eight facial configurations per subject, comprising one neutral portrait and seven expressions (Figure 2 ). We score each generated face by its maximum embedding cosine similarity to the subject’s gallery, which provides a more expression-robust face similarity metric. We additionally report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions, together with the fraction of generated frames in each regime. This makes failures at high expression intensity visible and helps interpret scores when methods produce different expression distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将表达多样化的参考样本作为条件设定和评估的共同基础。 在评估中，我们为每位受试者收集了标准化的八种面部配置图库，包括一张中性肖像和七种表情（图 2）。 我们通过生成面孔与受试者图库之间的最大嵌入余弦相似度对每张面孔进行评分，这提供了一种对表情变化更具鲁棒性的面孔相似度指标。 此外，我们还分别报告了轻度、强烈和极端表情下的身份相似度，以及各区间内生成帧的比例。 这使得高表情强度下的失败情况变得显而易见，并有助于在方法产生不同表情分布时解释评分结果。

paragraphs.en: For generation, we extend Stand-In ( Xue et al., 2026 ) to condition on multiple references of the same person. The model is an efficient 315M-parameter LoRA adapter with only 25k training steps at batch size 16. Expression-diverse references provide complementary observations of the subject’s facial appearance that are absent from a single portrait. To train the model, we curate consistent and diverse face crops from OpenHumanVid ( Li et al., 2024 ) and vary the number of conditioning references during training. When multiple captures are unavailable, we use LivePortrait ( Guo et al., 2024 ) to synthesize expressive references from a single neutral portrait, using driving expressions from a subject outside the evaluation set. This allows the same video generator to operate from a single portrait. Although identity similarity is lower than with real references, it still exceeds that of all evaluated baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成方面，我们对 Stand-In（Xue et al., 2026）进行了扩展，使其能够以同一人物的多个参考图像为条件。 该模型是一个高效的 3.15 亿参数 LoRA 适配器，在批量大小为 16 的情况下仅需 2.5 万步训练。 表情多样化的参考图像提供了对主体面部外观的互补性观察，而这些信息在单张肖像中并不存在。 为了训练该模型，我们从 OpenHumanVid（Li et al., 2024）中整理出一致且多样化的面部裁剪，并在训练过程中调整条件参考图像的数量。 当无法获取多个拍摄素材时，我们使用 LivePortrait（Guo et al., 2024）从单张中性肖像合成具有表情的参考图像，并利用评估集之外的主体所表现出的表情作为驱动。 这使得相同的视频生成器也能基于单张肖像进行运行。 尽管身份相似度低于使用真实参考图像的情况，但仍高于所有经过评估的基线模型。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on a controlled benchmark containing 10 subjects and 48 expression-focused prompts per subject. Both real and synthetic reference galleries achieve higher nearest-gallery identity similarity than all evaluated baselines in each of the three intensity regimes. Under extreme expressions, CurricularFace similarity, is 74.80 with real galleries and 68.36 with synthetic galleries, compared with 60.95 for the strongest baseline (Table 2 ). Ablations compare expression-diverse references with repeated neutral portraits and pose-diverse neutral references, examining the role of expression coverage beyond reference count (Table 5 ). Across both recognizers and all evaluated baselines, our real-gallery model wins on at least 97.9% of matched subject–prompt pairs. The win rate remains at least 96.1% on the subset where our model produces greater peak expression intensity, providing additional evidence that identity gains can persist under stronger facial deformation (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个受控基准数据集上进行评估，该数据集包含 10 个主体，每个主体有 48 个以表情为重点的提示。 在三种强度区间中，真实和合成的参考图库均实现了比所有被评估基线模型更高的最近图库身份相似度。 在极端表情情况下，CurricularFace 的真实图库相似度为 74.80，合成图库相似度为 68.36，而最强的基线模型仅为 60.95（表 2）。 消融实验将表情多样化的参考图库与重复的中性肖像以及姿势多样化的中性参考图库进行比较，以研究参考数量之外表情覆盖范围所起的作用（表 5）。 在所有识别器和所有被评估的基线模型中，我们的真实图库模型在至少 97.9% 的匹配主体-提示对中都取得了胜利。 在我们的模型产生更高峰值表情强度的子集中，胜率仍保持在至少 96.1%，这进一步证明身份识别能力的提升在面部变形更强烈的情况下依然有效（表 3）。

sents.en: Across both recognizers and all evaluated baselines, our real-gallery model wins on at least 97.9% of matched subject–prompt pairs.

paragraphs.en: We identify and quantify the dependence of single-reference face similarity on expression intensity in real imagery and introduce a standardized gallery-based multi-reference evaluation protocol stratified by expression intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别并量化了单参考人脸相似性对真实图像中表情强度的依赖关系，并提出了一种按表情强度分层的标准图库式多参考评估协议。

paragraphs.en: We develop expression-diverse multi-reference conditioning and its data-curation pipeline, which enables the model to better capture person-specific facial deformations under expressive motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种具有表达多样性的多参考条件生成方法及其数据清洗流程，该方法使模型能够更准确地捕捉表情动作中因人而异的面部形变。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate improvements in identity similarity with both real expression reference galleries and reference galleries synthesized from a single portrait, both surpassing baselines in all expression regimes and especially the intense and extreme ones, even when multiple-expression captures are not available.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，无论是使用真实表情参考图库，还是使用从单张肖像合成的参考图库，身份相似性都得到了提升。在所有表情类型中，这些方法都优于基线模型，尤其是在强烈和极端表情方面；即便在没有多表情捕捉数据的情况下，这一优势依然存在。

paragraphs.en: Video Generation Models provide the generative backbone for human video synthesis. CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2024 ) combines a temporally compressive 3D VAE with an expert transformer to produce long, coherent text-conditioned clips. Wan2.2 ( Wan Team, 2025 ) introduces a two-expert architecture specialized for high- and low-noise denoising stages, providing a backbone for multiple downstream tasks. LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) jointly models video and audio, while MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) accepts multimodal character and motion references for video generation and editing. These general-purpose models provide strong visual priors, but text conditioning lacks precise control over the subject’s identity in generated videos, whereas image-to-video generation generally requires a complete initial frame rather than just a reference portrait.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型为人类视频合成提供了生成性基础架构。 CogVideoX（Yang 等人，2024）将一种具有时间压缩能力的三维 VAE 与专家级 Transformer 相结合，从而生成长且连贯的文本条件化视频片段。 Wan2.2（Wan 团队，2025）引入了一种双专家架构，专门用于高噪声和低噪声的去噪阶段，为多种下游任务提供了基础架构。 LTX-2（HaCohen 等人，2026）联合建模了视频和音频，而 MiniMax H3（MiniMax，2026）则接受多模态的角色和动作参考，用于视频生成与编辑。 这些通用模型虽然提供了强大的视觉先验知识，但其文本条件化机制难以对生成视频中主体的身份进行精确控制；相比之下，图像到视频的生成通常需要完整的初始帧，而不仅仅是参考肖像。

paragraphs.en: Identity-Preserving Video Generation conditions pretrained video generation backbones on reference images of one or more identities. The most common approach is to use a single reference image per identity and inject its features into the video generator. ConsisID ( Yuan et al., 2025b ) decomposes a reference face into low-frequency global features and high-frequency local details and injects them at different depths of a diffusion transformer. Concat-ID ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) instead concatenates VAE-encoded reference features with video latents, while Stand-In ( Xue et al., 2026 ) adds a lightweight conditional image branch with restricted self-attention and conditional position mapping. Phantom ( Liu et al., 2025 ) learns joint text–image injection from text–image–video triplets.
paragraphs.zh: 身份保留视频生成方法将预训练的视频生成主干模型与一个或多个身份的参考图像进行条件约束。 最常见的方法是为每个身份使用单张参考图像，并将其特征注入到视频生成器中。 ConsisID（Yuan 等，2025b）将参考人脸分解为低频全局特征和高频局部细节，并在扩散变换器的不同层级注入这些特征。 相比之下，Concat-ID（Zhong 等，2025）将经过 VAE 编码的参考特征与视频潜在表示进行拼接，而 Stand-In（Xue 等，2026）则添加了一个带有受限自注意力和条件位置映射的轻量级条件图像分支。 Phantom（Liu 等，2025）通过文本–图像–视频三元组学习联合的文本–图像注入机制。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking Video Generation Models for facial identity similarity typically relies on a single reference. VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluates video generation along 16 disentangled dimensions. Its subject-consistency metric compares DINO features across frames of a generated video, measuring temporal stability but not facial identity relative to a reference person. OpenS2V-Eval ( Yuan et al., 2025a ) more directly evaluates subject-to-video generation. For human identity, its FaceSim protocol detects faces and computes CurricularFace ( Huang et al., 2020 ) cosine similarity to the input face. However, as we show below, this single-reference comparison can penalize genuine identity-preserving expression changes when the generated face departs from the reference expression. Our benchmark instead compares each frame with the nearest member of a standardized expression gallery and reports results stratified by expression intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 用于评估视频生成模型面部身份相似性的基准测试通常仅依赖单一参考图像。 VBench（Huang 等人，2024）从 16 个解耦的维度对视频生成进行评估。 其主体一致性指标通过比较生成视频中各帧的 DINO 特征来衡量时间稳定性，但并未评估与参考人物相比的面部身份相似性。 OpenS2V-Eval（Yuan 等人，2025a）更直接地评估了从主体到视频的生成过程。 在人类身份识别方面，其 FaceSim 协议会检测面部特征，并计算与输入面孔的 CurricularFace（Huang 等人，2020）余弦相似度。 然而，如下文所示，这种单一参考图像的比较方式可能会惩罚那些真实保留身份但生成面孔与参考表情有所偏离的表情变化。 我们的基准测试则通过将每一帧与标准化表情库中最接近的表情样本进行比较，并按表情强度分层报告结果。

paragraphs.en: Facial Reenactment and Related Tasks. Facial reenactment animates a source portrait using head pose and expressions extracted from a driving video. LivePortrait ( Guo et al., 2024 ) extracts appearance features from a single source image, estimates implicit 3D keypoints for the source and driving frames, warps the source features according to their motion, and decodes the result into animated frames. Person-specific 3D approaches such as GaussianAvatars ( Qian et al., 2024 ) instead rig optimized 3D Gaussians to a parametric face model, and video face-swapping systems such as OmniFace ( Guo et al., 2026 ) transfer a source identity onto an existing target video while preserving its motion and scene. These tasks receive an explicit driving signal and are distinct from our text-driven generation setting.
paragraphs.zh: 面部重演及相关任务。 面部重演通过从驱动视频中提取的头部姿态和表情，使源肖像动画化。 LivePortrait（Guo 等，2024）从单张源图像中提取外观特征，估算源帧和驱动帧的隐式 3D 关键点，根据这些关键点的运动对源特征进行形变，并将结果解码为动画帧。 而像 GaussianAvatars（Qian 等，2024）这样针对特定人物的 3D 方法，则是将优化后的 3D 高斯分布拟合到一个参数化面部模型中；像 OmniFace（Guo 等，2026）这样的视频换脸系统，则能将源身份转移到现有的目标视频中，同时保留其运动和场景。 这些任务接收明确的驱动信号，与我们基于文本的生成设置不同。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 isolates the effect of expression diversity by comparing three sets of eight references: repeated neutral images, pose-diverse neutral images, and expression-diverse images. paragraphs.en: We design our network to treat the reference images as an unordered set, so all the references are assigned the same temporal embedding to avoid introducing an ordering bias during training. For comparison, we also train a variant that assigns each reference a distinct temporal embedding. During training, we shuffle the reference images, and for each image i = 1 , 2 , ⋯ , N i=1,2,\cdots,N in the shuffled order, we assign it a temporal embedding − ( i + 1 ) -(i+1) on the video-to-image attention path. Reference-image self-attention retains the shared coordinate − 1 -1 . This negative-temporal variant is trained and evaluated with the same eight expression-diverse references and generation settings as ours. The shared-coordinate model achieves higher identity fidelity in all regimes, shown in Table 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将网络设计为将参考图像视为一个无序集合，因此所有参考图像都被分配了相同的时序嵌入，以避免在训练过程中引入排序偏差。 作为对比，我们还训练了一个变体模型，该模型为每个参考图像分配一个独特的时序嵌入。 在训练期间，我们会对参考图像进行打乱处理，并对打乱顺序中每个图像 i = 1, 2, ⋯, N 在视频到图像的注意力路径上分配一个时序嵌入 −(i+1)。 参考图像的自注意力机制保留了共享坐标 −1。 这个负时序变体模型与我们使用相同的八个表情多样化的参考图像和生成设置进行训练和评估。 共享坐标模型在所有情况下都实现了更高的身份保真度，如表 6 所示。

paragraphs.en: We show the limitations of a single neutral portrait for capturing person-specific facial changes and evaluating identity under strong expressions. To address this, we introduce an expression-diverse gallery for evaluation and propose a multi-reference conditioning model, which improves identity similarity across all expression-intensity regimes, especially under extreme expressions. These results highlight the importance of expression diversity in identity-preserving video generation. We encourage future work to provide larger expression-diverse datasets for benchmarking and training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了单一中性肖像在捕捉个体面部变化以及评估强烈表情下的身份识别方面的局限性。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个表情多样化的图库用于评估，并提出了一种多参考条件模型，该模型能够提升所有表情强度区间内的身份相似性，尤其是在极端表情下。 这些结果凸显了表情多样性在保持身份一致的视频生成中的重要性。 我们鼓励未来的研究提供更大规模的表情多样化数据集，以用于基准测试和训练。

paragraphs.en: We detect the faces with SCRFD-10g ( Guo et al., 2021 ) at a detection size of 640 × 640 640\times 640 with a confidence threshold of 0.5 0.5 . When more than one face is found we keep the one with the highest detection confidence. The detector’s five facial keypoints define a similarity transform to the standard ArcFace template, giving a 112 × 112 112\times 112 aligned crop; this single crop is embedded by both recognizers, ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) and CurricularFace ( Huang et al., 2020 ) . Identity similarity is the cosine similarity between ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized embeddings, reported × 100 \times 100 , following the convention of Wang et al. (2026) . Frames with no detectable face are dropped from all frame-level statistics, and a video with no detectable face in any sampled frame is excluded from the paired comparisons. The share of sampled frames with a detected face is above 98.8 % 98.8\% for every evaluated method and above 99.7 % 99.7\% for ours.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 SCRFD-10g（Guo 等人，2021）在 640 × 640 640\times 640 的检测尺寸和 0.5 0.5 的置信度阈值下检测人脸。 当检测到多个人脸时，我们保留检测置信度最高的人脸。 该检测器的五个面部关键点定义了与标准 ArcFace 模板之间的相似性变换，从而得到一个 112 × 112 112\times 112 的对齐裁剪图像；这两个识别器——ArcFace（Deng 等人，2019）和 CurricularFace（Huang 等人，2020）——都会对这个单一的裁剪图像进行嵌入。 身份相似性是指 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 归一化嵌入向量之间的余弦相似度，以 × 100 \times 100 的形式报告，遵循 Wang 等人（2026）的惯例。 未检测到人脸的帧会从所有帧级统计中剔除，而任何采样帧中均未检测到人脸的视频则会被排除在配对比较之外。 在所有评估的方法中，检测到人脸的采样帧比例均高于 98.8 % 98.8\%，而我们的方法则高于 99.7 % 99.7\%。

paragraphs.en: OpenS2V-Eval ( Yuan et al., 2025a ) evaluates general-purpose subject-to-video generation. It is therefore not designed specifically for the task studied in this paper: preserving facial identity under controlled, high-intensity expression changes using multiple reference images. In particular, its prompts do not systematically elicit high-intensity expressions, and it provides only one reference image per subject. Still, for context, we evaluate on the full Human-Domain protocol of 60 videos: 30 single-face and 30 single-human entries, each with one reference image and one text prompt. Because the benchmark provides only one reference per entry, we construct an eight-image gallery using our LivePortrait-based synthetic-reference pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: OpenS2V-Eval（Yuan 等人，2025a）评估了通用型主体到视频生成任务。 因此，它并非专门为本论文所研究的任务而设计：即利用多张参考图像，在受控的高强度表情变化下保留面部身份特征。 具体而言，其提示词并未系统性地引发高强度表情，且每个主体仅提供一张参考图像。 尽管如此，为提供背景信息，我们在包含 60 个视频的完整 Human-Domain 协议上进行了评估：其中 30 个为单面条目，30 个为单人条目，每个条目均含一张参考图像和一个文本提示。 由于该基准测试每个条目仅提供一张参考图像，我们利用基于 LivePortrait 的合成参考流程构建了一个包含八张图像的图库。

paragraphs.en: We follow the official OpenS2V-Eval Face Similarity evaluator and leaderboard aggregation.
